name: Empty
description: A minimal static starter — the Vibe to Cloud logo on a page, served by nginx. No build, no backend. The fastest way to a live URL you can edit with Claude Code.

name: Room bookings
description: A room booking calendar with day and week views. Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma + Postgres; double-booking is prevented and demo data is seeded so it is not empty on first open.

name: Visitor sign-in
description: A visitor sign-in board for a reception desk or a tablet by the door. Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma + Postgres; shows who is in the building and for how long, with demo data seeded.

name: Enquiry inbox
description: A contact form and the shared inbox for what it collects. Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma + Postgres; enquiries can be marked as dealt with, and obvious bot submissions are dropped.

name: API Service
description: REST API using Fastify + TypeScript + Prisma + Postgres. Health check gated on the database, migrations applied on deploy.

name: AI App
description: Claude-powered chat API (Fastify + @anthropic-ai/sdk). Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from a secret; no database.
